# K4-Technology

K4 Technology provides independent owner-side gas-engine technical advisory for power developers and asset owners. Work spans platform and fleet selection, new-versus-pre-owned strategy, equipment due diligence, lifecycle economics, reliability architecture, owner's engineering and operating-data review.

## Power developer advisory

K4 acts as an external gas-engine competence layer for distributed, captive and behind-the-meter power projects, including data-center, AI/HPC, mining and industrial applications. The advisory framework is SELECT → VERIFY → OPERATE. Reliability and availability conclusions remain bounded by the stated evidence and assumptions; K4 does not publish unconditional uptime guarantees.

## Evidence-Based Gas Engine Technical Due Diligence

Public scopes: Quick Technical Review — USD 450; Full Remote Technical Due Diligence — USD 950; On-Site Technical Inspection — By Quote. Decision states: BUY, BUY WITH CONDITIONS, PRICE ADJUSTMENT, DO NOT BUY.

Evidence labels distinguish OEM DATA, VERIFIED PUBLIC DATA, FIELD EVIDENCE, K4 FIELD DATA, K4 CASE STUDY and K4 ANALYSIS. Missing or seller-reported evidence is not upgraded to fact.
